Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one reusable transparent photo-frame overlay for the Japanese KOHZO PHOTO commemorative camera app. Create ONE portrait frame, 3:4 aspect ratio. The photo window must be genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha and cover at least 80 percent of width and 78 percent of height. The entire background, spaces between ornaments, and the large central opening are genuinely TRANSPARENT, no painted checkerboard, no white fill, no photo, no people. Decorations hug only the outer edges and corners, leave middle clear for faces. A thin rounded rectangular border is fully visible with a small safety inset from canvas edges, no cropping. Friendly minimal hand-drawn Japanese souvenir style, soft rounded imperfect strokes, clean flat colored line illustration, readable at phone size. Restrained ornament sizes, beautifully balanced spacious composition. No shadows, no typography, no words, no numerals, no watermark, no branding. Output production-ready transparent PNG overlay.
Input image 1 is a character and stroke-style reference only. Preserve the distinctive cute sky-blue doodle mascot shown in the reference: wide wobbly horizontal jellyfish-like body, two happy curved closed eyes and smiling mouth, a raised appendage on its right, several thick wiggly tentacles, unfilled transparent interior, thick sky-blue rounded marker lines. Do not copy the text below the character. Place one medium-small recognizable mascot at bottom-left corner and one tiny rotated mascot at upper-right, with a few small bubbles along side borders. Border uses matching sky blue with a very pale cyan second fine line. Keep the doodle's handmade personality. Never fill the center.
